attributes.title: APhA2027 Annual Meeting & Exposition
attributes.summary:
APhA2027, the American Pharmacists Association's annual meeting, runs March 19 to 22, 2027, at the Charlotte Convention Center in Charlotte, North Carolina, with The Westin Charlotte as headquarters hotel. APhA marks it as its 175th anniversary meeting. Education sessions run Friday and Monday, the exposition with presentation theaters opens Friday evening and runs Saturday and Sunday, and the APhA House of Delegates meets at the start and end of the meeting.

Attendees earn continuing pharmacy education credit for the education sessions, but APhA has not published the total number of CE hours or ACPE activity numbers yet. Early-bird rates run until February 12, 2027: $830 for members and $1,215 for nonmembers for the full meeting, with lower rates for new practitioners, students, pharmacy technicians and retirees and one-day passes from $390. Technicians have their own registration rates, but the official pages do not yet state technician CE hours.

Friday's keynote is Salim Ismail and Sunday's is Sekou Andrews. The 2028 meeting is planned for Seattle (March 17 to 20, 2028).
